description: This PHP class 'FilterDonor' provides methods to filter and retrieve donor user data based on various criteria such as project, call, channel, social commitments, date range, amount, donor type, status, wallet, certification, language, and location. It constructs complex SQL queries to fetch filtered donor information and count matching donors.

classes.name: FilterDonor
classes.description: A class for filtering and retrieving donor user data based on multiple criteria, constructing complex SQL queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FilterDonor with a Filter object.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Builds SQL query parts and parameters based on filter criteria, returning inner SQL, filter conditions, and parameter values.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Returns the count of donors matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getDonors
methods.description: Retrieves a list of donor User objects based on filter criteria, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getSqlFilter
methods.description: Generates SQL query and parameters for fetching filtered donor data.
